text:
Jaya: Hey — quick q: I started on Feb 15. When should I expect my first paycheck and when do benefits become active? Also I need to submit receipts for the relocation stipend — do we use Expensify or a form? And how are observed holidays prorated for mid-month joiners? Thanks!
Marisol (People Ops): Welcome Jaya! :tada: Payroll is semi-monthly (15th & last day). New hire pay can land on the next cycle depending on payroll cutoff. If you started on Feb 15, your first pay may be on Feb 28 or Mar 15 depending on cutoff. Payroll team can confirm — tagging Samir.
Samir (Payroll): FYI payroll cutoff is 5pm PT on the 1st and 16th. For Feb 15 start your pay likely processes on 02/28. If any hours/adjustments are missing we'll push a correction next cycle. Please make sure direct deposit + W-4 are submitted in Workday ASAP.
Jaya: Got it. Where do I upload moving receipts? Do I need supervisor approval?
Marisol (People Ops): Use Expensify and select policy `Redwood-Relocation`. Steps:
```
Expensify -> New Expense -> Upload receipt(s) -> Category: Relocation Reimbursement -> Add note: 'Relocation stipend - Jaya' -> Attach approval from manager
```
Yes, please add your manager's approval as a comment in Expensify. If you're missing access DM me and I'll invite you.
Jaya: What docs are needed for benefits dependent verification? Also if my benefits effective date is 1st of next month, can I backdate to start date? 
Eli (Benefits): Hi Jaya — benefits typically effective 1st of the month following your start date. For a 02/15 start that means 03/01 effective. Retroactive effective dates are rare; if you have a qualifying event or need earlier coverage for medical reason we can escalate but will need justification and documentation. For dependent add we need one of: marriage certificate, birth certificate, or insurance card + proof of relationship (utility bill) — upload to Workday under 'Benefits documents'.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: Benefits enrollment due in 30 days. Link: https://workday.redwood.example/enroll
Jaya: Thanks! Last Q — how are company holidays prorated? If there's a company holiday on Feb 20 (presidents' day) do I get that day paid? 
Marisol (People Ops): Holiday pay is prorated if you started after the holiday cutoff for that pay period. For US holidays we apply full holiday pay if you were on payroll the day before the holiday. For a 02/15 start you'd be eligible for 02/20 holiday pay. PTO accrual is pro-rated by calendar month — check the Holiday & PTO policy in the handbook: https://handbook.redwood.example/holidays
Samir (Payroll): Also, if your relocation reimbursement is a stipend vs reimbursement it may be taxable and show up on your paycheck as income. If you want to confirm tax treatment, send the estimated amount and I'll flag it with benefits/payroll.
Jaya: Perfect — uploading receipts now. Appreciate the fast help! :smile:
Marisol (People Ops): Welcome again! Ping me if Expensify invite doesn't come through.
